posts.preview: This morning, I attended the 2nd Southern African Conference on Tobacco Taxation under the theme: “From Dependency to Domestic Resource Mobilization: Strengthening Tobacco Tax Systems to Combat NCDs and Mobilize Domestic Resources.”
The main focus is on increasing taxes on tobacco products to mobilize domestic resources to fund health programmes and other developmental agendas across African countries

As part of my contribution to the conference, it is critical for the Tobacco Taxation Advocacy Group to bring labour to the table to advance a Just Transition aimed at protecting workers as the advocacy agenda continues to increase tobacco taxes across Africa See less
